ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels in the central region versus 35% high-intensity (white) pixels on distal lobe sections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct contiguous white pixel clusters on the distal third of both lobes; transition zones between black and white regions exhibit high-frequency mottling; central fluke area consists of solid low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve visible on the outer distal margins of both lobes tapering toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters of varying white and tan intensities localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle colonization present on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white distal pigmentation on the ventral surface.
